items.item_text: Current BLS from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross - required
Ambulance attendant and ambulance driving experience – highly desired

Become a key member of a world-class health organization and play an essential role in delivering exceptional patient care. Take your career to the next level. U can do all this and more at UCLA Health!

In this exciting and rewarding position, you will serve as an Emergency Medical Technician (EMT/Senior EMT) within UCLA Health’s specialized Critical Care Transport team, supporting the safe and efficient ambulance transport of patients across our renowned health system. You will provide Basic Life Support (BLS) level care and work alongside highly skilled critical care professionals to assist in the transport of neonatal, pediatric, and adult patients. Working within your EMT scope of practice, you will contribute to a collaborative, fast-paced environment dedicated to patient safety, clinical excellence, and compassionate care. Join our team today!
Commitment to supporting world-class care as part of a highly specialized Critical Care Transport team
Demonstrated ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, continuously changing environment
Excellent physical assessment skills and strong comprehension of medical terminology
Ability to read and write in standard English and communicate clearly and concisely with patients, families, and healthcare team members during the transport process
